title: Q3 Earnings Season (Alcoa, Interactive Brokers, Home BancShares, BNY, Ares, Fastenal)
summary: Gotrade News - Third-quarter earnings season picked up this week as Fastenal (FAST) and Home BancShares reported on Wednesday, October 14, followed by BNY
body_markdown:
Home BancShares posted record quarterly net income of $129.5 million, or $0.65 per diluted share, up from $119.3 million in the second quarter, as reported by[Quiver Quantitative](https://www.quiverquant.com/news/Home+BancShares+Posts+Record+%24129.5+Million+Third-Quarter+Net+Income) from the bank's filing. Its net interest margin was 4.53%, return on average assets was 2.12%, and book value per share reached a record $22.74 after the bank repurchased 1.3 million shares.


## Thursday, Oct 15: BNY (BK), Interactive Brokers (IBKR) and Alcoa (AA)


According to[BNY's earnings release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001390777/000139077726000104/ex991_earningsreleasex3q26.htm) , diluted EPS rose 24% to $2.34 ($2.37 adjusted) on total revenue of $5.7 billion, up 12% year over year. Fee revenue grew 12% to $4.1 billion and net interest income climbed 15% to $1.4 billion, while assets under custody and/or administration reached $63.4 trillion.


> "With broad-based growth across our platforms, we increased revenue by 12% year-over-year, delivering significant operating leverage and earnings per share growth of 24%." (Robin Vince, CEO, BNY)


BNY reported a return on tangible common[equity](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/what-is-equity-in-finance/) of 29.0% and returned $1.4 billion to common shareholders, including $937 million of share repurchases, per the same release.


Per[Interactive Brokers' third-quarter release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001381197/000138119726000154/ibkr-ex99_1.htm) , reported diluted EPS was $0.69 ($0.67 adjusted) versus $0.59 a year earlier, on net revenues of $1.91 billion. Commission revenue rose 12% to $602 million on 18% higher daily average revenue trades, net interest income increased 19% to $1.15 billion, and customer accounts grew 35% to 5.58 million.


The broker also raised its quarterly[dividend](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/dividend-yield-meaning-and-formula/) to $0.15 per share from $0.0875, payable December 14, and kept a 78% pretax margin, the release said.


## Alcoa (AA) Signs Massena East Sale Worth Up to $315 Million


According to[Alcoa's third-quarter results release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001675149/000119312526422891/aa-ex99_1.htm) , the aluminum producer earned $483 million, or $1.81 per diluted share ($1.82 adjusted), on revenue of $3.70 billion, down from $3.97 billion in the second quarter. Adjusted EBITDA excluding special items was $789 million.


Alcoa said it signed definitive agreements to sell portions of its Massena East, New York site for potential proceeds of up to $315 million. The company expects about $50 million to $65 million at closing, depending on approved data center capacity, plus $60 million to $250 million over seven years from capacity expansions and installment payments; closing is expected within six months, subject to permits and approvals.


Alcoa reaffirmed its 2026 alumina and aluminum production and shipment ranges, and CEO William Oplinger said the company is working toward closing the AliGroup acquisition in the first half of 2027.


## Ares Management Reports Thursday, Oct 29


Ares Management will release third-quarter results before the NYSE opens on Thursday, October 29, with a conference call at 9:00 a.m. ET that day, according to the[company's October 2 announcement](https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/ares-management-ares-management-corporation-updates-the-time-of-its-earnings-conference-call-for-the-third-quarter-ending-september-30-2026-20261002) .
